 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "intro_md",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# ChemView — Interactive Trajectory Analysis\n",
    "\n",
    "`ChemView` is a wrapper around [Chemiscope](https://chemiscope.org/) that turns\n",
    "ASE trajectories into linked scatter-plot + 3-D structure viewers inside Jupyter\n",
    "notebooks. You define which properties to compute via short string *specs*;\n",
    "ChemView handles the rest.\n",
    "\n",
    "This tutorial uses a **glycine AIMD trajectory** (3 624 frames, 10 atoms/frame)\n",
    "computed at the DFT level. The examples progress from basic energy monitoring to\n",
    "conformational analysis, bond correlations, and atom-level force inspection.\n",
    "\n",
    "---\n",
    "\n",
    "## Glycine atom indices\n",
    "\n",
    "| Index | Symbol | Role |\n",
    "|------:|:------:|:-----|\n",
    "| 0 | N | Amino nitrogen |\n",
    "| 1 | C | Cα (alpha carbon) |\n",
    "| 2 | C | Carboxyl carbon |\n",
    "| 3 | O | Carbonyl oxygen (C=O) |\n",
    "| 4 | O | Hydroxyl oxygen (C–OH) |\n",
    "| 5 | H | Hα₁ |\n",
    "| 6 | H | Hα₂ |\n",
    "| 7 | H | HN₁ |\n",
    "| 8 | H | HN₂ |\n",
    "| 9 | H | H(OH) |\n",
    "\n",
    "---\n",
    "\n",
    "> **Static viewers:** Interactive panels below use pre-generated data.\n",
    "> In your own Jupyter session `ChemView(...)` returns a live widget linked to your kernel."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "setup_code",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from ase.io import read\n",
    "from sparc.src.utils.chemview import ChemView"
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "load_md",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Load the trajectory\n",
    "\n",
    "Any ASE-readable format works (`.traj`, `.xyz`, `.extxyz`, VASP `OUTCAR`, …)."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "load_traj",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Frames: 3624,  atoms/frame: 10,  symbols: ['N', 'C', 'C', 'O', 'O', 'H', 'H', 'H', 'H', 'H']\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "traj = read('_static/TrajCombined.traj', index=':')\n",
    "print(f\"Frames: {len(traj)},  atoms/frame: {len(traj[0])},  \"\n",
    "      f\"symbols: {traj[0].get_chemical_symbols()}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ex1_md",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "---\n",
    "\n",
    "## Example 1 — Energy landscape\n",
    "\n",
    "The simplest usage: plot **potential energy vs frame index** to monitor\n",
    "thermalisation, drift, or phase transitions over the simulation.\n",
    "\n",
    "`map_color` sets the scatter-plot colour property — here energy itself gives\n",
    "a continuous colour gradient from low (blue) to high (red)."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "ex1_code",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "application/vnd.jupyter.widget-view+json": {
       "model_id": "ex1widget",
       "version_major": 2,
       "version_minor": 0
      },
      "text/plain": [
       "ChemiscopeWidget(meta={'name': 'ChemView'}, settings={'target': 'structure', 'structure': [{'unitCell': False…"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ChemView(\n",
    "    frames=traj,\n",
    "    specs=[\"frame\", \"energy\"],\n",
    "    names=[\"frame\", \"energy\"],\n",
    "    x=\"frame\",\n",
    "    y=\"energy\",\n",
    "    map_color=\"energy\",\n",
    "    meta_name=\"Glycine AIMD — Energy landscape\",\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "raw",
   "id": "ex1_iframe",
   "metadata": {
    "raw_mimetype": "text/html"
   },
   "source": [

    "        width=\"100%\" height=\"520\"\n",
    "        style=\"border:none;border-radius:6px;display:block;margin:1em 0;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.15);\">\n",
    "</iframe>"

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ex2_md",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "---\n",
    "\n",
    "## Example 2 — Carbonyl and hydroxyl bond dynamics\n",
    "\n",
    "Track the **C=O** (atoms 2→3) and **C–OH** (atoms 2→4) bond lengths\n",
    "simultaneously. Scatter-plot axes are frame vs C=O distance, coloured by\n",
    "energy. Clicking a point in the scatter plot highlights the corresponding\n",
    "frame in the 3-D viewer.\n",
    "\n",
    "When the same spec type appears more than once, use `names` to assign\n",
    "distinct, human-readable keys."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "ex2_code",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "application/vnd.jupyter.widget-view+json": {
       "model_id": "ex2widget",
       "version_major": 2,
       "version_minor": 0
      },
      "text/plain": [
       "ChemiscopeWidget(meta={'name': 'ChemView'}, settings={'target': 'structure', 'structure': [{'unitCell': False…"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ChemView(\n",
    "    frames=traj,\n",
    "    specs=[\"frame\", \"energy\", \"distance:2,3\", \"distance:2,4\"],\n",
    "    names=[\"frame\", \"energy\", \"d_CO\", \"d_COH\"],\n",
    "    x=\"frame\",\n",
    "    y=\"d_CO\",\n",
    "    map_color=\"energy\",\n",
    "    meta_name=\"Glycine AIMD — Carboxyl bond dynamics\",\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ex3_md",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "---\n",
    "\n",
    "## Example 3 — Conformational landscape (Ramachandran-style)\n",
    "\n",
    "Map the **N–Cα–C angle** (atoms 0,1,2) against the **N–Cα–C–O dihedral**\n",
    "(atoms 0,1,2,3) — a Ramachandran-style projection that reveals which\n",
    "conformations are sampled during the AIMD run.\n",
    "\n",
    "Each scatter-plot point is one MD frame. Clustering or gaps in this plot\n",
    "indicate preferred conformations or energy barriers."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "ex3_code",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "application/vnd.jupyter.widget-view+json": {
       "model_id": "ex3widget",
       "version_major": 2,
       "version_minor": 0
      },
      "text/plain": [
       "ChemiscopeWidget(meta={'name': 'ChemView'}, settings={'target': 'structure', 'structure': [{'unitCell': False…"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ChemView(\n",
    "    frames=traj,\n",
    "    specs=[\"energy\", \"angle:0,1,2\", \"dihedral:0,1,2,3\"],\n",
    "    names=[\"energy\", \"ang_NCaC\", \"phi\"],\n",
    "    x=\"ang_NCaC\",\n",
    "    y=\"phi\",\n",
    "    map_color=\"energy\",\n",
    "    meta_name=\"Glycine AIMD — Conformational landscape\",\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ex4_md",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "---\n",
    "\n",
    "## Example 4 — Bond-length correlations\n",
    "\n",
    "Plot **C–N** vs **C=O** bond lengths to expose their dynamical correlation.\n",
    "Resonance effects in the carboxyl group couple these two bonds: elongation\n",
    "of one tends to shorten the other. Colour by **C–OH** bond length to add a\n",
    "third dimension.\n",
    "\n",
    "All four bond distances are computed in a single `ChemView` call; the\n",
    "axes and colour can be changed interactively in the viewer."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "ex4_code",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "application/vnd.jupyter.widget-view+json": {
       "model_id": "ex4widget",
       "version_major": 2,
       "version_minor": 0
      },
      "text/plain": [
       "ChemiscopeWidget(meta={'name': 'ChemView'}, settings={'target': 'structure', 'structure': [{'unitCell': False…"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ChemView(\n",
    "    frames=traj,\n",
    "    specs=[\"frame\", \"energy\",\n",
    "           \"distance:0,1\",   # N–Cα\n",
    "           \"distance:1,2\",   # Cα–C\n",
    "           \"distance:2,3\",   # C=O\n",
    "           \"distance:2,4\"],  # C–OH\n",
    "    names=[\"frame\", \"energy\", \"d_NCa\", \"d_CaC\", \"d_CO\", \"d_COH\"],\n",
    "    x=\"d_NCa\",\n",
    "    y=\"d_CO\",\n",
    "    map_color=\"d_COH\",\n",
    "    meta_name=\"Glycine AIMD — Bond-length correlations\",\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {

   "id": "ex4_iframe",
   "metadata": {

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ex5_md",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "---\n",
    "\n",
    "## Example 5 — Atom-level forces and index colouring\n",
    "\n",
    "Atom-level specs (one value per atom per frame) expose per-site dynamics.\n",
    "Here `force_norm` stores the DFT force magnitude |**F**ᵢ| for every atom\n",
    "in every frame.\n",
    "\n",
    "* `color_atoms=\"atom_index\"` colours atoms by their index (rainbow scale)\n",
    "  so you can visually track individual atoms across frames.\n",
    "* `show_index=True` displays the integer index next to each atom in the\n",
    "  3-D viewer — useful when building new specs.\n",
    "\n",
    "Click any atom in the structure panel to see its `force_norm`, `atom_index`,\n",
    "and any other per-atom properties in the info panel."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "ex5_code",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "application/vnd.jupyter.widget-view+json": {
       "model_id": "ex5widget",
       "version_major": 2,
       "version_minor": 0
      },
      "text/plain": [
       "ChemiscopeWidget(meta={'name': 'ChemView'}, settings={'target': 'structure', 'structure': [{'unitCell': False…"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ChemView(\n",
    "    frames=traj,\n",
    "    specs=[\"frame\", \"energy\", \"force_norm\"],\n",
    "    names=[\"frame\", \"energy\", \"force_norm\"],\n",
    "    x=\"frame\",\n",
    "    y=\"energy\",\n",
    "    map_color=\"energy\",\n",
    "    color_atoms=\"atom_index\",\n",
    "    show_index=True,\n",
    "    meta_name=\"Glycine AIMD — Atom forces\",\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ex6_md",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "---\n",
    "\n",
    "## Example 6 — Single-structure viewer\n",
    "\n",
    "A single `ase.Atoms` object can be passed directly — useful for inspecting\n",
    "an optimised geometry or the lowest-energy frame of a trajectory.\n",
    "\n",
    "Set `plot=False` to suppress the scatter plot and show only the 3-D viewer.\n",
    "Atom-level position specs (`x_pos`, `y_pos`, `z_pos`) let you colour atoms\n",
    "by their Cartesian coordinates."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "ex6_code",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "application/vnd.jupyter.widget-view+json": {
       "model_id": "ex6widget",
       "version_major": 2,
       "version_minor": 0
      },
      "text/plain": [
       "StructureWidget(meta={'name': 'ChemView'}, settings={'target': 'structure', 'structure': [{'unitCell': False,…"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "# pick the minimum-energy frame\n",
    "energies = [float(np.asarray(at.get_potential_energy()).flat[0]) for at in traj]\n",
    "min_frame = traj[int(np.argmin(energies))]\n",
    "\n",
    "ChemView(\n",
    "    frames=[min_frame],\n",
    "    specs=[\"x_pos\", \"y_pos\", \"z_pos\"],\n",
    "    names=[\"x\", \"y\", \"z\"],\n",
    "    x=\"x\",\n",
    "    y=\"y\",\n",
    "    plot=False,\n",
    "    color_atoms=\"atom_index\",\n",
    "    show_index=True,\n",
    "    meta_name=\"Glycine — lowest-energy frame\",\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "tips_md",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "---\n",
    "\n",
    "## Tips and reference\n",
    "\n",
    "### Supported specs\n",
    "\n",
    "| Spec | Target | Unit | Notes |\n",
    "|:-----|:------:|:----:|:------|\n",
    "| `\"frame\"` | structure | — | Frame index |\n",
    "| `\"energy\"` | structure | eV | From `atoms.get_potential_energy()` |\n",
    "| `\"distance:i,j\"` | structure | Å | Bond/non-bond distance |\n",
    "| `\"angle:i,j,k\"` | structure | deg | Valence angle at j |\n",
    "| `\"dihedral:i,j,k,l\"` | structure | deg | Torsion angle |\n",
    "| `\"volume\"` | structure | Å³ | Periodic cell volume |\n",
    "| `\"cell_a\"`, `\"cell_b\"`, `\"cell_c\"` | structure | Å | Lattice lengths |\n",
    "| `\"cell_alpha\"`, `\"cell_beta\"`, `\"cell_gamma\"` | structure | deg | Lattice angles |\n",
    "| `\"x_pos\"`, `\"y_pos\"`, `\"z_pos\"` | atom | Å | Cartesian positions |\n",
    "| `\"force_norm\"` | atom | eV/Å | Force magnitude |\n",
    "| `\"force_x\"`, `\"force_y\"`, `\"force_z\"` | atom | eV/Å | Force components |\n",
    "| `\"symbol\"` | atom | — | Element symbol |\n",
    "| `\"atomic_number\"` | atom | — | Atomic number Z |\n",
    "\n",
    "`atom_index` is always added automatically — no need to list it in `specs`.\n",
    "\n",
    "### Key parameters\n",
    "\n",
    "```python\n",
    "ChemView(\n",
    "    frames=traj,           # list of ase.Atoms\n",
    "    specs=[...],           # property specs to compute\n",
    "    names=[...],           # optional: rename keys (same length as specs)\n",
    "    x=\"frame\",             # scatter-plot x axis\n",
    "    y=\"energy\",            # scatter-plot y axis\n",
    "    z=None,                # optional: 3-D scatter z axis\n",
    "    map_color=None,        # scatter-plot colour property\n",
    "    color_atoms=\"element\", # 3-D viewer colouring: \"element\" | \"atom_index\" | None\n",
    "    labels=False,          # show element labels on atoms\n",
    "    show_index=False,      # show integer index on atoms\n",
    "    env_cutoff=3.5,        # environment sphere radius (Å)\n",
    "    plot=True,             # show scatter-plot panel\n",
    "    meta_name=\"ChemView\",  # dataset label\n",
    ")\n",
    "```"
   ]
  }
